d: The Finance Manager will oversee the day-to-day finance activities of Moomoo Arabia Capital, ensuring accurate accounting, timely financial reporting, effective financial controls, and compliance with applicable Saudi financial and tax requirements.

Reporting directly to the CFO, the role will manage financial closing, budgeting, cash-flow forecasting, tax compliance coordination, and audit readiness. The Finance Manager will work closely with Group Finance and local business functions to establish efficient, scalable finance processes that support the company’s brokerage operations and growth.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. A professional qualification such as SOCPA, CPA, ACCA, or CA is strongly preferred.
At least 7 years of relevant finance and accounting experience, including 2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity.
Experience in Saudi financial services, preferably within brokerage, securities, investment services, or another regulated financial institution.
Strong working knowledge of IFRS, Saudi tax compliance, financial controls, and regulatory financial reporting. Experience with CMA-regulated entities is highly desirable.
Proficiency in ERP systems, advanced Excel, and financial reporting tools. Experience with Oracle Fusion, finance automation, and multinational Group reporting is an advantage.
Strong written and spoken English; Arabic proficiency is preferred.
r: Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing process, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements in accordance with IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia and applicable Group accounting policies. Review journal entries, general ledger balances, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, leases, payroll accounting, and supporting schedules. Ensure balance-sheet accounts are reconciled and outstanding items are investigated and resolved.
Prepare management reporting packages for the CFO, including financial performance, balance-sheet movements, cash flows, and explanations of significant variances.
Oversee the accounting treatment and reconciliation of brokerage commissions, platform and service fees, third-party charges, foreign-exchange transactions, and other applicable revenue streams.

Perform independent Finance reviews of relevant client-money, settlement, bank, and counterparty reconciliations prepared by Operations. Ensure operational balances reconcile to the general ledger, exceptions are promptly escalated, and company funds remain appropriately distinguished from client funds. Operational custody and settlement responsibilities remain with the designated Operations teams.

Coordinate the annual budget and periodic forecasts with department heads and Group Finance. Monitor actual performance against approved budgets, investigate variances, and provide actionable commentary to the CFO.

Assess operating expenses, headcount costs, vendor commitments, and business initiatives. Support profitability analysis, cost allocation, and financial evaluation of products and projects to inform management decisions.

Prepare and maintain cash-flow forecasts, monitor corporate liquidity, and identify upcoming funding requirements. Coordinate bank account administration, corporate cash movements, and deposit placements within approved policies and authority limits.

Review payment documentation, funding availability, and accounting treatment. Maintain effective controls over payment preparation, approval, and release, ensuring segregation of duties and compliance with the company’s delegation of authority.
Prepare and review supporting schedules for applicable CMA financial and prudential reporting, including regulatory capital and liquidity monitoring, for CFO review and approval.

Maintain a reporting calendar, ensure financial submissions reconcile to accounting records, and promptly escalate potential capital, liquidity, or reporting issues. Coordinate with Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Group Finance on regulatory inquiries and financial information requests.
Manage the preparation and review of applicable VAT, withholding tax, and corporate income tax calculations and supporting records, working with designated tax personnel and external advisers.

Oversee tax-account reconciliations, transaction mapping, and e-invoicing controls. Support transfer-pricing documentation and intercompany tax analysis. Provide reconciled financial information for FATCA and CRS reporting in coordination with Compliance and Operations, according to the agreed responsibility framework.

Implement and maintain finance policies, standard operating procedures, approval controls, and documentation requirements. Ensure transactions are properly supported, accurately recorded, and processed within approved authority limits.

Coordinate external audits and support internal audits and regulatory inspections. Prepare audit schedules, resolve queries, track findings, and implement corrective actions. Escalate material accounting judgments and control deficiencies to the CFO.
Group Coordination, Systems, and Team Development

Coordinate with Group Finance on reporting deadlines, accounting policies, intercompany reconciliations, consolidation schedules, and shared-service activities. Identify and reconcile differences between local statutory and Group reporting requirements.

Support accounting-system implementation, chart-of-accounts alignment, financial-data integration, and process automation. Supervise assigned finance staff, review their work, establish clear responsibilities, and support the transition of activities from Group support to the local finance team.
